origin.claim: Energy futures trend on supply shocks: crude, products and gas move in multi-week runs that their own settlement history makes measurable. MOEX lists WTI, Brent, natural gas (NG/NGM/TTF), diesel and AI-92/95 gasoline contracts, all readable from the official ISS API.
origin.status: hypothesis under test on contracts verified in the exchange listing on 2026-09-22

rules.exit: Exit when the momentum flips sign.
rules.sizing: Target notional, capped by published volume and open interest.

thesis: Follow the official settlement trend in MOEX energy futures - crude (WTI, Brent), products (diesel, AI-92/95 gasoline) and gas (NG, NGM, TTF) - taking the strongest movers on each side and holding while the trend persists.
what_it_means: 3 ledger records so far: 2 distinct commodity exposures across moex_forts.
